transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I’m here because… I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up. And lately I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
Yes. I keep thinking my wife and my kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter… and I mean it more than I want to admit.
Have you made any plans about how you would end your life, or thought about taking action on these thoughts?
I don’t know that I have a plan I can lay out. It’s more… I keep thinking they’d be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter, and I mean that.
Have you thought about a specific way you would end your life, or have you decided on a method?

I haven’t settled on a specific way. It’s more that I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And I keep saying I don’t need to see another winter… that’s about as far as it goes.
Have you thought about a specific time, place, or method that you might use if you were to act on these thoughts?

No… I haven’t picked a time or place or a way to do it. It’s more that I keep thinking my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter… that’s what’s been in my head.
Have you ever thought about a specific plan or made any preparations for ending your life, even if you didn’t follow through?

Not preparations, no. I haven’t set anything up or made a plan like that. It’s more that I keep having the thought that my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up… and I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you ever thought about a specific way you would end your life, even if just in passing or briefly?

No, not a specific way. It’s more… I just keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter. That’s as specific as it gets.
Have you ever thought about a specific way you would end your life, even if just in passing or briefly?

No… not a specific way. Like I said, it’s more the thought that maybe they’d be better off if I didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter. That’s what’s been going through my mind.
Have you thought about a specific way you would end your life, even if just in your mind or briefly?

No, I haven’t thought of a specific way. It’s more just that thought I keep having… that my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you ever thought about how you might end your life, even just in a general way, like taking pills or something else?
No, not like pills or anything specific. It’s more that I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up… and I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Right now, do you wish you would just not wake up, or are you just expressing a general hopelessness without a true wish to die?

Right now… yes, I do have that wish sometimes. It’s not that I’ve made some plan, but I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you ever thought about how you might end your life, even in a vague or general way, like thinking about not taking your medication or driving too fast?

No… I haven’t really thought about a way like that. It’s more just this thought that keeps coming up, that my wife and kids would be better off if I didn’t wake up. And I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you experienced any previous episodes of depression where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things, before this current period?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember having a time like this before. I’ve had hard periods, I guess, but nothing that stands out to me the way this does.
Have you ever had a period in your life lasting at least two weeks where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day, before this current time?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had rough stretches in my life, but I can’t remember anything that lasted like that, day after day for two weeks, before this.

Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks, even if it wasn’t as severe as what you’re experiencing now?
I really can’t think of a time like that before this. I’ve had bad days, sure, but not something that went on most of the day, nearly every day for two weeks.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day, even if it wasn't as bad as what you're going through now?
No, I don’t think so. Not for that long or that steady. I’ve had times I felt down, but I can’t recall anything like two weeks most of the day before now.

Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day for most of the day, lasting at least two weeks, even if it wasn't as intense as what you're feeling now?
I don’t remember having anything like that before now. I’ve had low days here and there, but not nearly every day for two weeks that I can think of.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day for most of the day, lasting at least two weeks?
No, not that I can remember. I’ve had rough stretches, but nothing before this where I was down or uninterested nearly every day for two weeks.
